name: pipe-runner
description: Isometric platformer game - Pipe Runner. A free, open-source game built with Phaser 3.

scripts.build:web: rm -rf build/web && mkdir -p build/web && cp -r index.html src vendor build/web/ && sed -i "s/\.js\"/.js?v=$(date +%s)\"/" build/web/index.html && echo 'Web build ready in build/web/'
scripts.build:android: npm run build:web && rm -rf cordova/www && cp -r build/web cordova/www && cd cordova && npm install && npx cordova prepare android && npx cordova build android
scripts.clean: rm -rf build/ vendor/ node_modules/ cordova/node_modules/ cordova/platforms/ cordova/plugins/ cordova/www/
